newsitem.title: USA: Pico Products names chief operating officer.
newsitem.headline: Pico Products names chief operating officer.

text.p: Pico Products Inc said Friday it has appointed Charles Emley Jr as chief operating officer.

Emley, who has been a director of the company since November 1993, is dean of the Peter F. Drucker Graduate Management Center of the Claremont Graduate School. Emley will remain dean of the Drucker Management Center while also working for Pico.
Chief operating officer is a new position at Pico, a company spokesman said.

"Mr Emley's assumption of the responsibility for overseeing day-to-day operations will allow me to concentrate on sales, corporate growth and strategic partnerships both in the United States and abroad," said Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Everett Keech.
